sloka: शार्दूल मृग संघुष्टम् सिंहैः भीम रवैः वृतम् ।नाना गुल्म लता गूढम् बहु पादप संकुलम् ॥४-२७-२॥
transliteration: śārdūla mṛga saṁghuṣṭam siṁhaiḥ bhīma ravaiḥ vṛtam ।nānā gulma latā gūḍham bahu pādapa saṁkulam ॥4-27-2॥

translations.english: The (Prasravana) mountain reverberated with the terrific roars of tigers and deer and lions. There were several kinds of shrubs, creepers and trees.It was inhabited by bears, apes, monkeys and wild cats in large number. The mountain was like a huge cluster of clouds. The waters in the ponds were pure.
translations.hindi: त शार्दूल ओर मर्गो आ था ओर बह्‌ प्रखबण पर्वत शार्दूल और मगो से भरा हुआ भयङ्कर सिंह उस पर दहाडा करते थे । अनेक प्रकार की माड़ि लदाओं और वृक्षों से वह भरा पूरा था
